info.description: Updates the information specified for an on-call rotation.
info.title: AWS Systems Manager Incident Manager Contacts

requests.description: Used to acknowledge an engagement to a contact channel during an incident.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.AcceptPage
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Activates a contact's contact channel. Incident Manager can't engage a contact until the contact channel has been activated.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.ActivateContactChannel
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Contacts are either the contacts that Incident Manager engages during an incident or the escalation plans that Incident Manager uses to engage contacts in phases during an incident.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.CreateContact
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: A contact channel is the method that Incident Manager uses to engage your contact.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.CreateContactChannel
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a rotation in an on-call schedule.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.CreateRotation
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates an override for a rotation in an on-call schedule.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.CreateRotationOverride
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: To no longer receive Incident Manager engagements to a contact channel, you can deactivate the channel.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.DeactivateContactChannel
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: To remove a contact from Incident Manager, you can delete the contact. Deleting a contact removes them from all escalation plans and related response plans. Deleting an escalation plan removes it from all related response plans. You will have to recreate the contact and its contact channels before you can use it again.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.DeleteContact
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: To no longer receive engagements on a contact channel, you can delete the channel from a contact. Deleting the contact channel removes it from the contact's engagement plan. If you delete the only contact channel for a contact, you won't be able to engage that contact during an incident.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.DeleteContactChannel
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes a rotation from the system. If a rotation belongs to more than one on-call schedule, this operation deletes it from all of them.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.DeleteRotation
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes an existing override for an on-call rotation.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.DeleteRotationOverride
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns the resolution path of an engagement. For example, the escalation plan engaged in an incident might target an on-call schedule that includes several contacts in a rotation, but just one contact on-call when the incident starts. The resolution path indicates the hierarchy of escalation plan > on-call schedule > contact.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=SSMContacts.ListPageResolutions
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Returns a list of shifts based on rotation configuration parameters.

The Incident Manager primarily uses this operation to populate the Preview calendar. It is not typically run by end users.

requests.description: Adds a resource policy to the specified contact or escalation plan. The resource policy is used to share the contact or escalation plan using Resource Access Manager (RAM). For more information about cross-account sharing, see Setting up cross-account functionality.

requests.description: Sends an activation code to a contact channel. The contact can use this code to activate the contact channel in the console or with the ActivateChannel operation. Incident Manager can't engage a contact channel until it has been activated.

requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Starts an engagement to a contact or escalation plan. The engagement engages each contact specified in the incident.

requests.description: Stops an engagement before it finishes the final stage of the escalation plan or engagement plan. Further contacts aren't engaged.

requests.note: Replace {{AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER_INCIDENT_MANAGER_CONTACTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
